scope: Publish validated contact figures, complete coverage corrections and retained failed rendering evidence.

figure_QA.scope: Matched front outer-boundary centroid maps with separately retained full raw maxima; curve/stencil-weight data trace to independently audited source fields.

corrected_contact_coverage.scope: Locate independently audited contact samples relative to fixed numerical refinement caps.
corrected_contact_coverage.limitations: Reference contact-sample positions are mapped to the same angular parameter used for numerical mesh marking; this is not a geodesic distance or resolved physical contact boundary. Unsigned sample-force norms avoid cancellation of opposing jaws and are not a traction-area integral. Incident trace edges are measured in the undeformed collision discretization. Samples outside caps reveal coverage gaps; samples inside caps do not exclude missed contact caused by coarse geometry elsewhere. No stress smoothing, force/geometry modification, convergence acceptance or original goal completion follows.

independent_corrected_contact_audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
independent_corrected_contact_audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

separate_body_finger_density_audit.scope: Measure separate body/finger discrete force densities from unchanged independently audited contact fields.
separate_body_finger_density_audit.limitations: These are discrete sample-force/lumped-area diagnostics, not continuous pressures, continuum contact areas or physical islands. Threshold1e-8N selects active samples for area/count reporting only; all forces contribute to density norms. No field, force law, raw global maximum or acceptance observable is changed, and no physical convergence follows from a fixed-bulk field tail.
